shortDescription: New Zealand’s ANZ Business Outlook Index dropped to 51.9 in September 2026 from 53.7 in the prior month, marking the lowest reading since June.The latest result highlighted a further moderation in business confidence amid ongoing cost pressures and uncertainty over the economic outlook.

title: New Zealand Business Sentiment Slips to 3-Month Low
